_instructions: Session task list texts. snapshot_heading opens the list in the instructions ({revision} is the list's revision when the snapshot was made); snapshot_rule follows it; snapshot_empty replaces the sections when there are none. step_line opens the one-line task state in each step's guidance message ({sections} lists each open section, its active step and its next open step); fold_hint follows it while a section with steps has not started and another section is closed ({section} is its id). Edited in place; no compile. end_reminder is sent once per run when the agent ends its turn with open steps ({steps} names them); unfiled_reminder joins the step's guidance message once unfiled_after_calls tool calls since the user's last message include no task_list_write ({calls} is that count, so the text changes each call and every harness passes it on). user_change_heading opens each change the user made from the chat's task panel, which the agent receives with its next model call. unfiled_requests joins each step's guidance message while user requests are neither cited nor set aside ({requests} names them). end_unfiled joins the end-of-turn reminder for the same. The task gate (tools whose task is required) uses gate_refusal ({problems} is gate_unfiled and/or gate_no_step), and when no section is open it opens one with the gate_placeholder_step step in progress, which reaches the agent under gate_change_heading.
snapshot_heading: Session tasks: this session's working list, as of revision {revision}; it ends with the session. Track each multi-step piece of work in it with task_list_write as you go; read it with task_list_read.
snapshot_rule: If another session or a later day would need something, it belongs in Main Notes; a step of the work in front of you belongs here.
fold_hint: Before starting {section}: if it does not need the details of the closed work, set fold_earlier on the task_list_write that starts its first step.
end_reminder: Before you end this turn: {steps} are still open in the session task list. Finish them, mark them blocked or cancelled with task_list_write, or answer without calling a tool to end the turn with your earlier reply.
unfiled_reminder: Session tasks: {calls} tool calls since the user's last message and none filed in the session task list. Write a section for this request now with task_list_write (a title and its steps), then mark the first step in_progress.
user_change_heading: The user changed the session task list (revision {revision}):
unfiled_requests: Unfiled requests: {requests}. Before your next change, cite each in requests on a section or step with task_list_write (a new section for new work, a step of an existing one for a follow-up), or set it aside with a reason if it needs no task.
end_unfiled: Before you end this turn: requests {requests} are not in the session task list. Cite each on a section or step, or set it aside with a reason, using task_list_write.
gate_refusal: This change was not made: the session task list must account for the work first. {problems} Call task_list_write: cite each request in requests on a section or step (a new section for new work, a step of an existing one for a follow-up) or set it aside with a reason, and start the step this change belongs to (status in_progress). Then make the change again.
gate_placeholder_step: Do the requested change (placeholder: replace with the real steps)
gate_change_heading: The task gate opened a section for your unfiled requests (revision {revision}); it was the only open work, so your change went ahead. Replace its placeholder step with the real steps now:
